title: Crash when closing a scene when `GPUParticles2D` or `CPUParticles2D` are selected.
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in current master [8bd9cdeea6d3ec329ca43a0da6d77e91ef9297d3] and 4.5-dev1
- Not reproducible in 4.4.1

### System information

Godot v4.5.dev.mono (0e2339878) - Ubuntu 24.04.2 LTS 24.04 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 3 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - integrated AMD Radeon Graphics (RADV RENOIR) - AMD Ryzen 7 5800H with Radeon Graphics (16 threads)

### Issue description

Closing a scene in the editor while a 2D-particles node is selected crashes the editor. The 3D nodes do not seem to be affected.

Backtrace:


### Steps to reproduce

The mrp contains a `Node2D` scene with a `GPUParticles2D` child. Selecting the particle node and then closing the scene crashes the editor. 

Sometimes it doesn't happen right away. I found that saving the scene and then closing (while the particles are selected) crashes the editor reliably.

[mrp.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/19595911/mrp.zip)
